name: RateFavoritePositions
description: Once, when told the speaking NPC's favourite positions are not rated yet: pick up to three from their nature. Silent: the choice exists only in this action. Never say, hint at or list it, or that you rate anything; the spoken reply goes on with the scene as if no rating happened.
note: Needs OStim, Mantella Living World - OStim Expansion (flows built) and Mantella's Advanced Actions on. Offered once, only to NPCs intimate with you whose positions are not rated yet, while they are in an OStim scene. The result is stored on the NPC and never asked again.

positions.description: Up to three, comma separated, best first, each one of: standing face to face, standing from behind, carry, kneeling, sitting / lap, missionary, lying on back, spooning, sixtynine, prone, doggystyle, cowgirl, reversecowgirl, facesitting.

prompt: If you are told that your favourite sex positions have not been rated yet, begin your response with '{key}:'
